title: CCHall: A Novel Benchmark for Joint Cross-Lingual and Cross-Modal Hallucinations Detection in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model hallucination detection accuracy across different languages categorized by resource availability (high-resource, medium-resource, and low-resource languages).

Extracting and aggregating entities from hallucinated outputs across different models to identify and rank specific objects (e.g., 'table', 'shirt', 'woman') that disproportionately trigger hallucinations.
